title: Special Topics in Intermediate Theatre and Performance; Foundations of Screen Acting
description: This introductory course offers a step by step process for the performer to dive into the basics of screen acting. Adjusting the actor's work from stage to film is emphasized. Technique also includes awareness of eye-line, pacing, and camera angle. Through self-taped/filmed monologue and scene work, students will learn critical tools for performance success in this new virtual medium. Access to a computer and smartphone (or other basic video recording device) needed.
